title: Konzultace pacienta
what_it_is: FNO's request form for an MDT consultation: a referring doctor fills it in to ask the neuro-oncology MDT (NOCO) about a patient. The FNO challenge deck (slide 5) calls it 'VZOR FORMULÁŘE PRO MDT TÝM, pracovní návrh vycházející ze struktury MDT protokolu FNO' (a template form for the MDT, a working draft based on the structure of FNO's MDT protocol).
type_note: Types come from the embedded HTML controls: text = single-line input, textarea = multi-line input, select = drop-down, checkbox. 'inferred' means the control was lost when the form was pasted into Word, so the type is read from the label.

fields.label: Pojišťovna pacienta
fields.note: Options not preserved. The PDFs show insurer codes such as 111, 205, 211.

sections.label: (no heading in the form; the deck calls it 'Informace o pacientovi', the PDFs 'Zdravotní stav a diagnózy')

fields.label: Otázka na NOCO
fields.note: Not marked (*) in the form, but it is what the MDT is asked to answer.

fields.label: Souhlasím, aby FNO použila uvedené osobní údaje ke zpracování požadavku, dle GDPR.
fields.label_en: I agree that FNO may use the personal data above to process the request, under GDPR.
